subject: GCP mid‑cycle usage split — need usage-to-invoice mapping and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Finance <finance@acme-acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Oct 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP mid‑cycle usage split — need usage-to-invoice mapping and VAT evidence

Hi team,

We noticed your October GCP Marketplace bill has mid‑cycle consumption that was split across two invoice lines (invoice 7954 and a provisional ledger entry). This is triggering a withholding flag on our marketplace settlement flow for EU VAT review and delaying the October payout.

Can you please:
- Confirm which Acme billing entity corresponds to invoice 7954 and the provisional line (company IDs or VAT IDs would be ideal).
- Share any available per‑SKU, per‑timestamp usage details for Sep 29–Oct 3 so we can map tokens/backfill ledger stamps.
- Include any reseller/aggregation chain if EdgeScale or another partner is acting as seller of record.

I attached a quick extract from our side (gcp-usage-stats-20291015.csv) showing the timestamp clusters that correspond to the split lines. If you can return a short CSV with project_id / sku / start_time / end_time / quantity / vat_flag / seller_id that will let us reconcile and unblock payout.

If you prefer, we can set up a 30m call tomorrow to walk through the mapping. Goal: avoid holding the entire October payout and get a partial credit processed if necessary.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Finance Ops (Marketplace Billing)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: gcp-usage-stats-20291015.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Acme Finance <finance@acme-acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeScale Marketplace Support <marketplace-support@edgescale.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Oct 2029 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: GCP mid‑cycle usage split — need usage-to-invoice mapping and VAT evidence

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for flagging — we see the two lines on our side and the ledger shows the consumption split across two internal billing entities: Acme EU (VAT ID: EU‑ACME‑998) and Acme Global (VAT ID pending). We do use EdgeScale for reselling on GCP Marketplace for some SKUs.

I attached a PDF snippet from our internal ledger that highlights the two lines and the seller mapping we have (acme-ledger-snippet.pdf). We can export per‑timestamp usage but it will take a couple hours to correlate projects to seller_id. Expect a CSV back to you EOD.

A couple notes:
- Invoice 7954 appears to be the official marketplace invoice (seller_id: edgescale-452). The provisional entry came from a delayed aggregation job and was not fully attributed at time of invoice generation.
- For VAT purposes, Acme EU is the taxable entity for these lines; please confirm if Redwood needs an invoice-level VAT breakdown or seller-level VAT evidence.

We can hop on a quick call tomorrow at 09:00 UTC if helpful.

Best,
Marta Varga
Head of Billing Operations
Acme Cloud Solutions

Attachment: acme-ledger-snippet.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Oct 2029 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GCP mid‑cycle usage split — need usage-to-invoice mapping and VAT evidence

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding Acme's confirmation. Key asks from our side to close reconciliation and release the withheld funds: 

1) Produce a consolidated evidence bundle for Acme that includes: invoice 7954 PDF, the provisional ledger export, per-SKU usage CSV with seller_id, and VAT registration docs for Acme EU.
2) Confirm whether EdgeScale is acting as seller_of_record on invoice 7954; if yes, we need the EdgeScale VAT number and reseller agreement excerpt to support VAT pass-through.
3) Prepare a short memo for Collections that outlines whether a partial credit can be issued for the portion attributable to Acme EU while the remaining disputed line is investigated.

I propose we:
- Ask Jonas to generate the marketplace entity map (project_id -> seller_id -> vat_flag).
- Marissa to draft the memo to Collections and Legal for partial credit authority.

Can you both confirm ETA? I can then loop Acme and EdgeScale and offer the 09:00 UTC call slot.

—Naomi

Naomi / Marissa — on it. I ran a quick join against our ingestion logs and attached a preliminary entity map (marketplace-entity-map.xlsx). It links project_id and invoice timestamps to seller_id and indicates where we lack a VAT flag.

Notes from the extract:
- ~38% of the disputed quantity matches seller_id edgescale-452 (matches invoice 7954).
- Remaining 62% are split between acme-eu and acme-global placeholder accounts — missing VAT ID for acme-global.
- The provisional ledger entry aligns to a delayed aggregation window (2029-09-30 23:50 -> 2029-10-01 00:20 UTC) which caused it to fall into a second billing batch.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll tidy the entity map into the evidence bundle and add per-sku aggregations by Oct 16 18:00 UTC.
- Marissa, can you confirm approval threshold for partial credits (we have a $25k threshold before VP signoff; request can be routed as exception for marketplace settlements).

Attachment: marketplace-entity-map.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)

Jonas

Hi Marta / EdgeScale team — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We are consolidating an evidence bundle now (invoice 7954 PDF, marketplace-entity-map.xlsx, per-sku CSV, and Acme VAT doc). We plan to:
- Push a partial credit of the Acme EU‑attributable amount (estimated 38% of the disputed line) on Oct 18 to avoid blocking October payouts; Collections will apply the credit once Legal confirms the VAT evidence is sufficient.
- Keep the disputed remainder under investigation; we will update you by EOD Oct 19 with either a full credit or invoice adjustment.

Action items for Acme/EdgeScale: please send the following by EOD Oct 17 so we can complete Legal review:
- EdgeScale VAT number and reseller agreement excerpt showing pass-through or seller_of_record language.
- Per-project seller_id mapping export (CSV) that includes project_id, timestamp, sku, quantity, seller_id, and invoice_reference.

If we don't get everything by EOD tonight we'll still proceed with a provisional partial credit but it may require a holdback until final evidence arrives.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership on this.
